name: Aoiro no Epitaph
source:
This world is full of pain. 
Marika was always bullied at school. To break from that past she passes Kunihiko to the ruler of the class. From this moment Kunihiko gets caught in a distorted vortex that overturns the world...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/08/vn-of-month-june-2008-rui-wa-tomo-o-yobu.html]vndbreview[/url]]
